decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w3' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8884. Series context: trend strength 0.3906 and seasonal strength 0.6954; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.29); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 6.94.
